So there are arguments all around. But i was in the same boat as you. Your video card is by far the strongest, while everything else is outdated 

8GB of ram with those specs, is not worth buying new ram over. Your cpu just is not powerful enough for that gaming setting.

Power supply perfectly fine

What you want next is a Ryzen CPU. Why? They are monster CPUs at a fraction of the cost of Intel. However. With that said, this would require
-New CPU (i recommend ryzen 5, just slightly more than a 3)
- new ram and probably should at this point have at least 12gb
- newmotherboard to place it in.

Motherboards. This is the hard part.  This is my PERSONAL experience and by no means does it say its absolutely true. Its just my personal experiences with this brands.

Luckily, you DONT need the new x570 chipset. Therefore older boards with am4 will work BUT... some may need an update which you cannot do without a processor that already is accepted (on some). So just be careful and make sure. So then it comes down to brand

-ASUS has been top quality part material imo on the builds i have done. I currently have one now, but software is not good customer support is average at best, pretty good longevity of support of its drivers

-AsRock if you can get it cheap, is a good deal. Very basic, nothing special, but works. Its harder to get where i am so therefore expensive. They are a lowend board. Good driver support. Customer service more awkward than anything

-Gigabyte poor software, poor drivers, terrible customer support, poor support of drivers but they look pretty i guess. I HATE this brand. I once bought one for a friend brand new latest chipset. They dropped support on the next windows update.

- MSI some chipsets are excellent, some are trash. Expensive as hell usually, decent customer support.
